title: Playlist and Homecoming
author: Ada Nystrom
blurb: Paloma Thornbury, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the final audition.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
